inputs.root_cause: SAL-UBL-OBL-B36305DA0BCEE0F6 (UBL-EXT-001)'s rule_text bundles two clauses: 'read and write extension containers with arbitrary namespaces and payloads without loss' (already proven) and 'expose registered typed adapters as opt-in' (not built). The obligation's own missing_behavior named the exact gap: no registry lets a caller register a typed decoder for a specific extension namespace, distinct from CodeListRegistry (business code-list values, not extension payload types).
inputs.acceptance_evidence: 10 new tests prove registry population (empty length, register/get round-trip, contains, replace-on-re-register) and decode behavior (registered adapter decodes correctly, unregistered QName is unknown not an error, unregistered node returned unchanged by identity, deterministic decoding, independent adapters per QName).
inputs.regression_tier: full ubl package suite (tests/python/ubl) plus 6-format regression

execution_steps: 1. After five consecutive evidence-strengthening ticks (events 247-251), surveyed ubl's remaining 29 unresolved obligations for both an already-diagnosed narrow gap AND a genuine status-crossing opportunity, per event 251's own exact_next_action noting a diversification was worth attempting.

2. Re-investigated SAL-UBL-OBL-49E8A72A55F540E1 (UBL-REF-001, 'broken references') first, since it had been repeatedly flagged as worth one more attempt -- confirmed via the original implementer's own commit message (d2e846bf) that cross-document reference resolution and wrapper-vs-leaf *Reference completeness both remain genuinely ambiguous/unbuildable without verified UBL schema data not available. Correctly deferred again rather than fabricating a rule.
3. Found SAL-UBL-OBL-B36305DA0BCEE0F6 (UBL-EXT-001) instead: its own missing_behavior text named a concrete, narrow, well-specified gap distinct from the already-implemented round-trip half.
4. Read codec/preservation.py directly and confirmed the round-trip-without-loss half is already fully proven (LOSSLESS mode preserves arbitrary foreign-namespace payloads by default).

5. Read model/codelist.py (CodeListRegistry) directly as the pattern to mirror -- an in-memory, caller-populated registry with immutable-on-register semantics and a tri-state (known/unknown) validation result shape (CodeListValidation).

6. Designed ExtensionAdapterRegistry (model/extension_adapters.py) as the QName-keyed analogue: register(qname, adapter)/get(qname)/__len__/__contains__ mirroring CodeListRegistry's exact method shapes, plus decode_extension(registry, node) returning ExtensionDecodeResult (qname, adapter_known, decoded, node) mirroring CodeListValidation's (list_known, is_valid, detail) shape.

7. Verified opt-in is structural, not just documented: an unregistered node's .node field is the SAME object passed in (identity-checked in tests), and decode_extension never raises -- calling it on every extension node in a document is always safe.

8. Wired ExtensionAdapter/ExtensionAdapterRegistry/ExtensionDecodeResult/decode_extension into model/__init__.py and the top-level ubl/__init__.py exports, following the exact import-ordering convention already used for CodeListRegistry's own exports.

9. Probed interactively before writing any test: registered an adapter for a vendor Audit QName, decoded a matching node (correct dict returned) and an unregistered QName (unknown, not an error, node returned unchanged by identity) -- both behaved correctly on the first attempt.

10. Ran the full pre-existing ubl suite (962 tests, zero new fixtures) against the new module and export wiring to look for false positives before writing a single new test -- all 962 passed unchanged.

11. Wrote 10 formal tests in a new test_obligation_extension_adapter_registry.py, mirroring test_obligation_codelist_registry.py's established two-class (TestRegistryPopulation/TestDecodeExtension) structure precisely. All passed on the first attempt.

12. Ran ruff (clean), mypy on the new module (clean), the full ubl suite (972 passed, was 962, +10), and the full 6-format regression (3458 passed, was 3448, +10; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.

13. Ran skills-first governance: resolve -> add-python-api (COMPOSE_EXISTING_SKILLS), manifest create --write (sfx-ec9aa0fa449af34f, confirmed as the actually-persisted manifest via ls -t .local/skills-first/manifests/), hand-written receipt YAML, closeout --close -> CLOSE_OK.

14. Promoted SAL-UBL-OBL-B36305DA0BCEE0F6 to implemented: both halves of its rule_text are now genuinely satisfied -- round-trip without loss (pre-existing) and registered typed adapters as opt-in (this slice). missing_behavior cleared to empty list.
